# NYC-Tron UI

> Themeable React Native and Expo component library (1.0.0-rc.2, release candidate, not on npm). 565 documentation pages: 64 hand-reviewed, 501 generated from type declarations. The app owns the theme: components read 13 colour variables and 2 radius variables.

Each page is raw markdown at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/<id>.md`, where `<id>` is the registry item id (the path under `components/`, for example `shell/UnitInput`). Every page has the same eight sections: Purpose, Install, Props, Variants, States, A11y, Example, Do/Don't. Pages marked `docs: "generated"` in their front matter were produced from `docs/api-signatures.json` and the source, not written by a person.

## Install and conventions
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/SKILL.md): how to find an item, the token rules, provider and peers, the six states, what not to do.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/AGENTS.md): repository rules and the Agent-native section.
- [README, Installing from a release](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/README.md): the tarball install, which is the install path that works today.
- [Theme tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/THEME_TOKENS.md): the 13 colour variables and 2 radii the consuming app must define. A missing variable fails silently.
- [components-contract.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/agent-native/components-contract.md): where installed files land (`@components/nyc-tron/ui`, `@lib/nyc-tron/core`), since components.json rejects unknown keys.
- [tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/agent-native/tokens.json): every token with its value, status (existing, proposed, proposed-scoped) and source.
- [registry.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/registry.json): the shadcn registry index. Item JSON is at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/r/{name}.json`.

Registry install, once the CLI check passes: `npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/<id>`. Find an item with `npx shadcn@latest search @nyc-tron -q "<what it does>"`. The namespace entry in `components.json` is `"@nyc-tron": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/r/{name}.json"`.

Rules in one paragraph: use token names, never colour or spacing literals; spacing keys are unit multiples (`space.2` is 8px, `space.1.5` is 6px) from a closed scale; render every component inside the app's theme CSS; handle default, loading, error, empty, success and offline states yourself, the library draws only what its props say.

## Layout primitives
Stack, Row, Spacer, Divider and Text exist under `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`. Use them before hand-rolled `View` rows.

## Components, hand-reviewed (64)
- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/Button.md): Pressable text button with primary, secondary, ghost and danger variants, loading spinner and icon slot, for React Native. a11y unverified.
- [Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/Card.md): Static container View with raised, sunken or transparent surface and optional padding, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Drag Grab Handle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/DragGrabHandle.md): Three-bar drag handle, 44 by 44 minimum, reporting start, move, commit and cancel through a pluggable transport, for React Native. a11y unverified.
- [Field Group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/FieldGroup.md): Form layout wrapper with titled sections and footer text, exposed as FieldGroup.Section, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Icon Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/IconButton.md): Icon-only pressable button with five variants and an optional selected toggle state, for React Native; web aria-pressed. a11y reviewed-fail.
- [List](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/List.md): Vertical list of rows with title, supporting text, leading and trailing slots; rows with onPress become buttons, for React Native. a11y reviewed-fail.
- [Navigation Rail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/NavigationRail.md): Vertical rail of icon and label destinations with selected state and a collapsed icon-only mode, for React Native. a11y unverified.
- [Segmented Control](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/SegmentedControl.md): Single-choice segmented control exposed as a radio group, for React Native; arrow-key navigation on web only. a11y unverified.
- [Select](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/Select.md): Single-select dropdown with flat or grouped options, hint and error text, for React Native; web combobox ARIA; QNX keyboard. a11y reviewed-fail.
- [Tab Bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/TabBar.md): Tab strip with tablist or link-navigation semantics, icons and compact density, for React Native; web roving focus. a11y unverified.
- [Text Field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/TextField.md): Labeled TextInput with helper text, error text, start adornment and error border state, for React Native. a11y reviewed-fail.
- [Toolbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/Toolbar.md): Header bar with title, leading slot and actions group in default or compact density; arrow-key focus on web, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Key Value List](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/content/KeyValueList.md): Label and value list that goes from one to two columns at a measured width, with empty-value text, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Data Table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/data/DataTable.md): Sortable data table on TanStack Table that renders cards below a width threshold, with optional row press, for React Native. a11y reviewed-fail.
- [Tree Grid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/data/TreeGrid.md): Tree table with expandable rows, row selection, column reorder and pinned columns, plus a compact layout, for React Native. a11y reviewed-fail.
- [Badge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/feedback/Badge.md): Small status badge with neutral, info, success, danger or accent tone, a status dot and size steps, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/feedback/Banner.md): Inline status banner with info, success, danger or neutral tone, title, description, action slot and dismiss button, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Empty State](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/feedback/EmptyState.md): Empty-list placeholder with heading title, description, icon or illustration, and an action or secondary exit button, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Error Message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/feedback/ErrorMessage.md): Inline error text with a danger glyph, announced as an alert; renders nothing when the message is empty, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Precision Scrubber](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/forge/inputs/PrecisionScrubber.md): Drag-to-scrub number control with fine, normal and coarse modes, detents, preview and commit callbacks, for React Native; web forced-colors. a11y unverified.
- [Property Inspector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/forge/inputs/PropertyInspector.md): Form built from a field list of number, choice, boolean and text properties, committing one change at a time, for React Native. a11y reviewed-fail.
- [Office Controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/forge/office/office-controls.md): ToolButton with checked and mixed toggle state, plus play, pause, skip, plus and chevron glyphs, for React Native; web aria-pressed. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Pan Responder Drag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/gestures/PanResponderDrag.md): Single-touch drag transport on React Native PanResponder, no gesture-handler dependency, for React Native and web. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Adaptive Columns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/layout/AdaptiveColumns.md): Wrapping column row; each AdaptiveColumns.Item sets a minimum width and grow factor, for React Native layout. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Content Frame](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/layout/ContentFrame.md): Width-capped container that aligns its content to the start, center or end of the parent, for React Native layout. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Divider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/layout/Divider.md): Decorative horizontal or vertical line, one border-width step thick, border colour role, no accessibility role, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Row](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/layout/Row.md): Horizontal flex View with the same token-keyed gap, padding, align, justify and wrap as Stack, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Spacer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/layout/Spacer.md): Empty View with a fixed length from the space scale, or flex to fill free space on the main axis, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Stack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/layout/Stack.md): Vertical flex View with token-keyed gap, padding, align, justify and wrap, no role and no colour, for React Native. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/layout/Text.md): Text with body or caption size from the token scale, a font-size override and a theme colour tone, no weight, for React Native. a11y unverified.
- [Collapsible Drawer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/navigation/CollapsibleDrawer.md): Side navigation drawer menu in expanded, compact or minimal mode, with overlay and scrim when open, for React Native; Android back. a11y unverified.
- [Anchored Popover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/overlays/AnchoredPopover.md): Modal popover placed against an anchor rectangle or trigger element and clamped to usable regions, for React Native; web Tab cycling. a11y reviewed-pass.
- [Command Palette](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/overlays/CommandPalette.md): Searchable command list in a modal, with keyboard selection and an empty-results message, for React Native. a11y reviewed-fail.
- [Command Popover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/overlays/CommandPopover.md): Anchored popover menu of command items, with disabled and danger items, for React Native, web and QNX. a11y unverified.
- [Adaptive Dock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/shell/AdaptiveDock.md): Dockable panel layout of tabbed and floating panels; merges into one stack below a width and avoids foldable hinges, for React Native. a11y unverified.
- [Asset Browser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/shell/AssetBrowser.md): Asset list with breadcrumb path, search, sort, single or multiple selection and async open, for React Native. a11y reviewed-fail.

## Limits stated plainly
- **Native-only packages are not installable by shadcn.** 55 subpaths in 9 packages ship native code (hardware-keys 2, macos-appkit 17, native-charts 3, native-controls 7, native-navigation 3, platform-services 7, reserved-regions 3, windows-fluent 3, windows-fluent-fabric 10). A registry add copies files and cannot run pod install, gradle, CMake, nitrogen or a WinUI build. Install them from the release tarball. List: [registry-excluded.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/registry-excluded.json).
- **Engine facades are not registry items.** cadence, folio, pitch, prism, quill, splice, tally and studio-layout need the Rust engine, which ships as a GitHub release tarball.
- **Registry install is unverified until the live check.** The CLI's acceptance of raw.githubusercontent.com content types was checked against a local server only. Registry URLs use ref `main`, a moving ref, until the owner cuts a release tag. They resolve only after this branch is merged to main. Before that, test against a local server. Until a clean app installs from the live URL, use the tarball path.
- **Accessibility statuses come from reading source, not from rendering.** Of the 64 hand-reviewed items: 23 reviewed-pass, 21 reviewed-fail, 20 unverified. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. `verified` is reserved for a rendered check and no page has it. The 501 generated pages say `declared` when the source sets an accessibility prop and `unverified` when it sets none.
- **Touch targets: 44pt passes Apple, 44dp is 4dp under Android's 48dp guideline.** 41 hand-reviewed items size a control with the literal 44 (finding F08 in docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md). WCAG 2.1 AA has no target-size criterion, so this is a guideline finding, not a conformance failure.
- **Icons: 47 glyphs are drawn; 42 of 1,463 catalog ids resolve to one; 6 drawn glyphs are not catalog ids.** An unresolved icon name renders nothing. Do not read the catalog size as availability.
- **No component preview exists.** The components are React Native, and nothing here renders them. Pages carry types, props, tokens and a type-checked example only.
- **Tier 1 prose reflects source at commit b91dfc3 (1.0.0-rc.2).** Token names in the front matter are what the source maps to today. They do not claim the literal-to-token codemod has run.
